changeSet.author: oriso
changeSet.sql: UPDATE case_handover_reason_policy SET client_consent_mode = CASE WHEN client_consent_required = 1 THEN 'OPT_IN' ELSE 'NONE' END; UPDATE case_handover_request SET client_consent_mode = CASE WHEN client_consent_required = 1 THEN 'OPT_IN' ELSE 'NONE' END; -- Retire the OTHER_EMERGENCY default only where the row still carries the untouched -- seeded values (0057/0059). Admin-edited policies are never overwritten, which also -- makes the rollback below exact: it restores precisely the seeded default. UPDATE case_handover_reason_policy SET enabled = 0, access_allowed = 0 WHERE code = 'OTHER_EMERGENCY' AND policy_authority = 'platform-admin-default-case-handover-policy' AND enabled = 1 AND access_allowed = 1 AND client_consent_required = 0;

rollback.sql: UPDATE case_handover_reason_policy SET enabled = 1, access_allowed = 1 WHERE code = 'OTHER_EMERGENCY' AND policy_authority = 'platform-admin-default-case-handover-policy' AND enabled = 0 AND access_allowed = 0 AND client_consent_required = 0;
